originalTitle: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 | Premiere Date Teaser Trailer
content: Ready to get burned again? From CD PROJEKT RED and TRIGGER, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premieres exclusively on Netflix on October 20. Prepare for a raw story of revenge and redemption with a taste of what’s to come for this brand-new cast of characters trying to survive in Night City. - TRAILER MUSIC "A Rusty Dream" — Releases on August 22, 2026. Pre-save now: cyberpunk.lnk.to/arustydream "A Rusty Dream" — written, performed, composed, and arranged by DOUDOU (Du Binger / Du Feier), produced by DOUDOU (Du Binger / Du Feier) & Yuyunhsieh, recorded, mixed and mastered by Yuyunhsieh Project Coordinator: Lucian Ma, Overall Coordinator: Modern Sky / Modern Sky Game House, Executive Producer: Meow Miu and Production Company: Pollux Music

chineseContent: 准备好再次被烧伤了吗？由 CD PROJEKT RED 和 TRIGGER 出品的《赛博朋克：Edgerunners 2》将于 10 月 20 日在 Netflix 独家首播。准备好迎接复仇与救赎的原始故事，体验一下试图在夜之城生存的全新角色将面临的命运。 - 预告片音乐《生锈的梦》 — 于 2026 年 8 月 22 日发布。立即预存：cyberpunk.lnk.to/arustydream 《生锈的梦》 — 由 DOUDOU（杜冰儿 / 杜飞儿）创作、表演、作曲和编曲，由 DOUDOU（杜冰儿 / 杜飞儿）和 Yuyunhsieh 制作，由 Yuyunhsieh Project 录制、混音和母带制作统筹：Lucian Ma、总统筹：摩登天空 / 摩登天空游戏屋、执行制作人：Meow Miu 制作公司：Pollux Music
